decisions.reason: The offshore and renewables unit sits close to the core ship-management business and gives the firm a growth option in offshore wind, an area whose value is still unfolding, while keeping it costs little because it reuses existing crews and systems.

Crew travel management is closely tied to crewing operations and was likely hurt only temporarily by the pandemic, so its uncertainty has not resolved against it and the low holding cost justifies keeping the option open.
The online vessel portal is a cheap digital option that supports customer proximity and the firm's digitalisation path, and there is no evidence yet that its value will not be realized.

The performance app fits the push for cleaner and more efficient shipping and costs little to maintain, but it could be merged into the portal or other platforms, so its drop risk is somewhat higher than the others.
